===== EXP1: CREATE USER 'lab_user'@'localhost' =====
user	host	plugin
lab_user	localhost	caching_sha2_password

===== EXP1: CREATE USER 'lab_user'@'%' (same username, different host) =====
user	host	plugin
lab_user	%	caching_sha2_password
lab_user	localhost	caching_sha2_password

===== EXP1: SHOW GRANTS both accounts =====
Grants for lab_user@localhost
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `lab_user`@`localhost`
Grants for lab_user@%
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `lab_user`@`%`

===== EXP1: are they independent accounts? create/drop one, other survives =====
user	host
lab_user	localhost
user	host
lab_user	%
lab_user	localhost
===== EXP2: login as lab_user (socket -> @localhost account) =====
USER()	CURRENT_USER()
lab_user@localhost	lab_user@localhost
Grants for lab_user@localhost
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `lab_user`@`localhost`
